items.title: Earl Turbinton Interview, 1990-09-01
items.q: I used to play on the radio every Sunday afternoon when I was in junior high school on a Peter Champ Clark show

ctx.x: Willie Humphrey, who's still alive and I think in his 80s now one of the great clarinet players. He and his brother Percy play down at Preservation Hall but Willie Humphrey I met through a scholarship I used to play on the radio every Sunday afternoon when I was in junior high school on a Peter Champ Clark show that was called Stars of Tomorrow and at that time my influences were Earl Bostic and Louis Jordan and I liked Sam Butera during that time and I remember him making a comment one time when I was playing…
